title: Settlement wise information of turnover/ delivery
text: Home »Legal»Circulars Settlement wise information of turnover/ delivery Jul 20, 1995| Circulars DIVISION CHIEF SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT - I SMD-I(N)/JJ/2727/95 20 July 1995 To, The President/ Executive Director of all the Stock Exchanges. Dear Sir, Settlement wise information of turnover/ delivery It is requested to furnish us with information regarding the turnover and the delivery in value terms as well as percentage delivery for every settlement form April 1, 1995 till date. You are also requested to furnish us this information on a regular basis for every settlement within 7 days from the close of the settlement. The format of the report is given hereunder. Clearing No. Settlement Period From To Volume Traded Delivery in value terms Percentage Delivery Yours faithfully, sd/- R.V. NABAR
